title: MusicDrop v1.7.3 — Mobile Tab Smooth Navigation & Native TV Video Engine
changelog:
• Rock-Solid Mobile Tab Navigation: Swiping carousels on Discover (categories, playlists, charts) no longer hijacks screen or switches tabs
• Header Stability: Eliminated twitchy collapsing top bar so buttons stay perfectly reachable with zero screen jitter
• Instant Smooth Tab Switching: Switching between Home, Songs, Playlists, Downloads, and Library is instantaneous with zero intermediate lag
• Native TV Video Playback: Full hardware-accelerated video rendering via ExoPlayer in TV mode with zero blank screens or iframe blocks
• Header De-clutter: Mobile top bar icons cleanly spaced without overcrowding
